05/07.08.2025

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with
Patratu P.S. Case No.198 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420, 506 and 34 of
the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ramgarh.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the case arising out of supply and manufacture of raw bricks.
He submits that the petitioners have demanded money for labour cost, which has been refused and, thereafter, false case has been lodged against the petitioners.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and submits that the allegations of demanding money are there.

4. It appears from the order passed by the learned Court that there is some transaction through RTGS and further it transpires that there is dispute with regard to non-supply of certain raw bricks Anil Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ...

Opposite ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159062667/
1 and in the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
( 2025:JHHC:22274 )
5.

Accordingly, the above-named petitioners are directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrender, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ramgarh in connection with Patratu P.S. Case No.198 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2)
of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
6. Accordingly, this application is disposed of.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Ajay/
